description: This file defines the DefaultClusterRolesConfig class which implements the HealthCheckConfig.ClusterRolesConfig interface. It provides configuration for cluster roles in the health check system, including whether the feature is enabled and the expected roles. It includes methods for creating instances from external configuration, and overrides for standard Object methods.

classes.name: DefaultClusterRolesConfig
classes.description: Immutable class that loads cluster roles configuration, indicating if it is enabled and which roles are expected.
